entries.heading: PROHIBITION ON CONDUCTING ADDITIONAL BASE REALIGNMENT AND CLOSURE (BRAC) ROUND
ancestors: TITLE XXVII—BASE REALIGNMENT AND CLOSURE ACTIVITIES
entries.text:
SEC. 2703. PROHIBITION ON CONDUCTING ADDITIONAL BASE REALIGNMENT 
                          AND CLOSURE (BRAC) ROUND.

    Nothing in this Act shall be construed to authorize an additional 
Base Realignment and Closure (BRAC) round.
